def BugeaudLaurentTranscendence : Prop :=
  ∀ θ β α : ℝ, Irrational θ → 0 < θ → θ < 1 →
    IsAlgebraic ℚ β → IsAlgebraic ℚ α → β ≠ 0 → α ≠ 0 →
